bead.title: Build microsite and operator deployment docs
bead.description:
Create the operator-facing microsite and deployment documentation for pqueue. The first screen should be useful to an operator, not a marketing landing page: install commands, backend profile choice, release artifact links, and production-readiness status should be immediately visible.

The docs must cover Helm install/upgrade/uninstall, values reference, postgres_native operation, object_log_sqlite_projection/S3-compatible operation, kind smoke testing, release artifact verification, troubleshooting, and known production gaps.

In-scope files:
- docs/** and/or a microsite source directory if the repo already has a docs-site pattern
- README.md docs links
- package/build config only if needed for the microsite
Out-of-scope:
- Changing application runtime behavior.
bead.acceptance:
1. The microsite/docs build command passes; if the site is static HTML, document the openable path and run any existing formatter/linter.
2. `rg -n "helm install|values|postgres_native|object_log_sqlite_projection|S3|MinIO|kind|release artifacts|troubleshooting" docs README.md` finds operator-facing coverage.
3. README links to the deployment docs or microsite.
4. The docs include explicit production readiness status for both backends and do not overclaim cloud S3 certification unless the kind/MinIO proof exists.
